QUOTE: "An index stamped by a newer build than this process expects cannot be cleared by any rebuild through this process." and "schema | index newer than server | no rebuild clears it"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that a schema-stale index, one newer than the server, can't be fixed by any rebuild through this process. It doesn't give the re-stamping reason, but the unresolvable-by-rebuild substance is stated.
